name: EFIT-AI-public-GitLab-single-HDF5-schema-and-access-audit

sample_HDF5_schema.thomson_fields: Each channel has electron temperature t_e/data and density n_e/data arrays and its own time, error and physical position r,z. This is relevant but only at 13 sparse sampled times in the example.
sample_HDF5_schema.challenge_actuator_mismatch: The file has only sparse equilibrium-slice PF-current constraints, with 24 unnamed entries; no public HDF5 root/group provides the challenge's named high-rate 18 F-coil plus ECOILA/bcoil/Ip actuator traces and distinct raw time bases. vacuum_toroidal_field/b0 is a field, not the bcoil current trace. The sample therefore cannot be used as a direct row-level replacement for challenge inputs.
sample_HDF5_schema.challenge_target_mismatch: The file contains 13 EFIT ψ grids of 129x129, while the challenge targets full selected shot sequences on a 65x65 grid. A physical-grid resampling rule would be needed even for labels.

bulk_and_license.bulk_access_status: The public dvc branch exposes pointer files and SSH-configured remotes, not an unauthenticated bulk HDF5 download or a complete public shot manifest. No access bypass or bulk download was attempted.
bulk_and_license.license_status: The GitLab repository root has a BSD LICENSE for repository contents, but its README does not explicitly specify separate HDF5 sample or underlying DIII-D research-data reuse terms. Do not infer a dataset-wide license or corpus availability from this single checked-in sample.
bulk_and_license.competition_rule_summary: Public external tokamak archives are allowed with methods-report disclosure, but this does not establish that the EFIT-AI bulk corpus is publicly downloadable, schema-compatible or disjoint.

overlap_and_safety.reason: Competition machine shot numbers are omitted from released rows and the single HDF5 sample lacks matching high-rate named actuator traces. No robust disjointness claim follows from comparing one sparse EFIT sample. Public/private input fingerprint matching was deliberately not attempted; organizer-approved identity/disjointness information would be needed before any external supervised training.

verdict: This one public, labeled, sparse HDF5 example confirms that EFIT-AI stores relevant equilibrium and Thomson quantities, but does not provide a usable challenge-compatible or demonstrably disjoint training corpus. Stop the external-data route on current evidence; no model fit or public submission was made.
